issue.title: Bug: gcu: generic config updater test_pfcwd_status.py test failure

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py failure
Test failure is observed on marvell-teralynx platform.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py test case
```
./run_tests.sh -n ptf2-m -d str-marvell-01 -c "generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py::test_start_pfcwd[single]" -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml -i ../ansible/lab,../ansible/veos -t t0,any -u
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior is test case failure.
```
generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py::test_start_pfcwd[single] FAILED             [ 75%]
generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py::test_start_pfcwd[all] FAILED                   [100%]
```

Test case is expected to pass

### Relevant log output

```shell

### Description of PR
Fix test_pfcwd_status.py failure
Fix verified on marvell-teralynx platform.

Summary:
Fixes #18456

### Type of change
- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)

- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202012
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [x] 202411

### Approach

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
#### How did you do it?
os_version format on DUT can be in any of 202411.1, 20241100.1
On DUT `gcu_field_operation_validators.conf.json` field validator version is in format of "20241100"

Because of the version comparison issue, test case is failing.
Also added marvell-teralynx asic_name in get_asic_name

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified by running generic_config_updater/test_pfcwd_status.py test on marvell-teralynx platform.

```
